svg.text: How a raster finds its mask: by MD5
DSC03049 record 1 (a Sky mask), followed from the XMP into the .acr and back onto the canvas
Every one of the 311 records in 77 files matched an XMP reference, and every reference matched a record.
The table is sorted by MD5, not by XMP order (77 of 77 files), so position means nothing; the MD5 is the link.
The local cache stores the same record as auxiliary\<md5>, byte for byte.
